Same-day party bus and limo booking in Scottsdale

Yes, Scottsdale Sprinters books party buses and limos the same day, with no cutoff and subject to availability. It confirms in writing what is open for your date and hour before you pay. Send your pickup address, time, headcount and hours, or call (623) 986-6339. The rate is the published one: Limo Party Sprinter (16 Pax) is $175 an hour with a 4-hour minimum, plus 8% tax. Below: what fits a last-minute group, what can go wrong, and what to ask.

Last updated: October 7, 2026

Can you book a party bus in Scottsdale the same day?

Yes, Scottsdale Sprinters books party buses and limos the same day. Availability varies by date and by vehicle. Same-day bookings are welcome with no cutoff, subject to availability. Request a current quote for your date and we confirm in writing what is open. There is no minimum notice to meet, but there is a real limit: a vehicle that is already booked for your hour cannot be offered. That is why the first step is a request, not a payment.

How do you book at short notice?

Send a request with your pickup address, pickup time, headcount and drop-off, or call (623) 986-6339 (email reservations@scottsdalesprinters.com). The reservations team replies with what is open and a written quote. Have four things ready: where the group is, where it is going, how many people, and how many hours you want. With those the quote is a calculation, not a negotiation. How the rest settles depends on how you pay: on a card, a 50% deposit holds the date and your written confirmation sets out the balance and its timing; paying in full at checkout leaves nothing else due before your ride; a payment link from the reservations desk opens that same checkout.

Which vehicle fits a last-minute group?

Pick the smallest vehicle with enough seats: Luxury SUV (Suburban) for 4, Limo Party Sprinter (16 Pax) for 16, 56-Passenger Motorcoach for 40. The table gives each fit and its minimum total with 8% tax. 4 riders: Luxury SUV (Suburban), $125/hr, 4 hours minimum, $540 with tax. 10 riders: Executive Black Sprinter, $145/hr, 4 hours minimum, $626 with tax. 16 riders: Limo Party Sprinter (16 Pax), $175/hr, 4 hours minimum, $756 with tax. 24 riders: Party Bus (28 Pax), $250/hr, 4 hours minimum, $1,080 with tax. 40 riders: 56-Passenger Motorcoach, $325/hr, 5 hours minimum, $1,755 with tax.

Does same-day cost more?

The rate is the vehicle’s published hourly rate, the same on a same-day request as on one made months ahead: for example Limo Party Sprinter (16 Pax) at $175 an hour with a 4-hour minimum. There is no rush fee in the rate grid, and tax is 8%. On a major-event date the quote for your date is confirmed in writing, and that written quote is the price. We do not post totals for event dates.

What can go wrong with a same-day booking?

The vehicle you want may be taken for that hour. Be flexible on the vehicle first, then on the start time by an hour or two. Cancelling is also tighter at short notice: on a standard single-vehicle booking, inside 72 hours a reservation is non-refundable, so book once the plan is set. Groups, multi-vehicle bookings and major-event dates follow longer windows on the policies page. If it moves, a free date change is available when asked 72 or more hours before pickup. Group size is the other limit. A group that is larger than the vehicles available for the hour may need two vehicles; the reservations team will say so in the reply.

Is a same-day party bus right for a birthday, a night out or a wedding?

It works for a night out, a birthday that moved, a concert group or a rained-out event. For a wedding or a large group, book as early as the date is known, because several vehicles must be free at once. A same-day ride is booked the same way as any other. You rent the whole vehicle, so the total depends on hours and vehicle, not the headcount, and a full cabin splits it: Limo Party Sprinter (16 Pax) has 16 seats. Once a vehicle and chauffeur are free, a night out is booked on the Scottsdale nightlife transportation page or the Scottsdale party bus rental page. A seated Sprinter is on the Scottsdale Sprinter van rental page. A wedding party is on the wedding transportation page, and a bachelor group is on the bachelor party transportation page. Same-day still depends on a free vehicle and chauffeur.

What are the rules on board?

Riders 21 and over may bring their own alcohol and drink on board; nothing is sold on board, and no alcohol comes on a trip with anyone under 21. There is no smoking or vaping inside any vehicle. Arizona’s open-container law, A.R.S. § 4-251, carries an exception for passengers in a for-hire vehicle.

What should you do while you wait for the reply?

Settle the headcount and the pickup address, because those two decide the vehicle and the route. Then agree who will confirm the booking and hold the card, so the quote is accepted in minutes rather than passed around a group chat. If the group is still growing, quote for the higher number. Moving up one vehicle size at short notice is harder than staying in the one you booked, and an empty seat costs nothing extra: the total belongs to the vehicle. Have a second pickup time in mind too. If the first hour is taken, a start an hour later is often open, and the quote will say so.

Who are you booking with?

Scottsdale Sprinters is permitted, licensed and insured. 5.0-star Google rating (544 Google reviews), 4.9 stars on Yelp. Read the policies page before you pay; it states the deposit and the cancellation tiers in full.

Frequently asked questions

Can I book a party bus for today?

Availability varies by date and by vehicle. Same-day bookings are welcome with no cutoff, subject to availability. Request a current quote for your date and we confirm in writing what is open.

Is there a cutoff for same-day bookings?

No. Same-day bookings are accepted with no cutoff, subject to availability.

How fast do you reply to a same-day request?

Call (623) 986-6339 for the quickest answer, or email reservations@scottsdalesprinters.com. The reply says what is open and gives a written quote.

Is a same-day party bus more expensive?

No rush fee is added. The price is the published hourly rate times your billable hours plus 8% tax, with a 4-hour minimum on the Limo Party Sprinter (16 Pax).

Do I have to pay when I book?

How the rest settles depends on how you pay: on a card, a 50% deposit holds the date and your written confirmation sets out the balance and its timing; paying in full at checkout leaves nothing else due before your ride; a payment link from the reservations desk opens that same checkout.

Can I change a same-day booking?

A free date change is available when asked 72 or more hours before pickup. Inside that window a change is treated as a cancellation.

Can I bring alcohol on a same-day booking?

Riders 21 and over may bring their own. Nothing is sold on board, and no alcohol comes on a trip with anyone under 21.

What should be ready when you call for a same-day ride?

Have the pickup address, the time, the headcount, and the hours. Call (623) 986-6339 or email reservations@scottsdalesprinters.com. The reply names what is free and quotes it in writing.

Which page books the ride once a vehicle is free?

A party night uses the Scottsdale party bus rental page or the Scottsdale nightlife transportation page. A Sprinter uses the Scottsdale Sprinter van rental page. A wedding uses the wedding transportation page, and a bachelor group uses the bachelor party transportation page.
